hosts.title: MongoDB Hosts
hosts.description: Comma separated list of MongoDB Host Addresses in host:port format.

collection.title: MongoDB Collection
collection.description: Sets the name of the MongoDB collection to bind to this endpoint.

username.title: MongoDB Username
username.description: Username for accessing MongoDB. The username must be present in the MongoDB's authentication database (authenticationDatabase). By default, the MongoDB authenticationDatabase is 'admin'.

ssl.title: Enable Ssl for Mongodb Connection
ssl.description: whether to enable ssl connection to mongodb

sslValidationEnabled.title: Enables Ssl Certificates Validation and Host name checks.
sslValidationEnabled.description: IMPORTANT this should be disabled only in test environment since can pose security issues.

database.title: MongoDB Database
database.description: Sets the name of the MongoDB database to target.

streamFilter.title: Stream Filter
streamFilter.description: Filter condition for change streams consumer.
